hero.title: It's gift day!
hero.description: Time to unwrap. Have fun, everyone.
hero.to-open: {count, plural, one {# gift to open} other {# gifts to open}}

mode-help.allAtOnce: In their turn, each person opens all their gifts.
mode-help.oneByOne: One gift per turn, round and round until nobody has any left.

order.mode-restart-description: The unwrapping starts over from the first person, in the same order.
order.spinning: Who's next? The reel is spinning…
order.reshuffle-description: Everyone gets a new unwrap order and the unwrapping starts over.

reveal.title: Who was whose Santa?
reveal.switch: Reveal the Santas after the gifts
reveal.description: At the end of the presenter view, everyone sees who was whose Santa. Not using the presenter? Then it's revealed when gift day is over.
reveal.on: The Santas are revealed after the gifts

after.title: How did it go?
after.description: Hope you got something lovely. Mark the wishes you got: they're archived, so nobody buys them again.

present.only-organizer: Only the organizer can open the presenter view.
present.intro-hint: Press → or space for the first person.
present.live-qr: QR code to follow along on your phone
present.reveal-hint: Press → or space to reveal who was whose Santa.

live.reveal-waiting: Watch the screen: who was whose Santa is coming up.

swap.steals: {count, plural, =0 {Not stolen yet} one {Stolen once} other {Stolen # times}}
swap.wrapped: {count, plural, one {# gift still wrapped} other {# gifts still wrapped}}
swap.hint: Open a wrapped gift or steal one that's open.
swap.hint-final: Swap for any gift that isn't frozen, or keep yours.
swap.label: What's in it? (optional)
swap.now-robbed: Stolen from, so they go again

errors.NOT_GIFT_DAY: The Santas can be revealed from gift day on.
errors.REVEAL_OFF: Turn on revealing the Santas first.
errors.EDITION_CHANGED: Someone changed this edition just now. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
